content: नायक {%a.%} [नी-ण्वुल्] Guiding, leading, conducting. .{@-कः@} .²1 A guide, leader, conductor. .²2 A chief, master, head, lord. .²3 A pre-eminent or principal person, distinguished personage; सैन्यनायकः <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 A general, commander. .²5 (In <ab>Rhet.</ab>) The hero of a poetic composition (a play or drama); (according to <ls>S. D.</ls> there are four main kinds of नायक:-- धीरोदात्त, धीरोद्धत, धीरललित, and धीरप्रशान्त, <ab>q. v.</ab>; these are again subdivided, the total number of kinds being 48; see <ls>S. D. 64-75</ls>. The Rasamañjarī mentions 3 classes पति, उपपति and वैशिक; <ls n="S. D.">95. 110</ls>). .²6 The central gem of a necklace; ‘नायको नेतरि श्रेष्ठे हारमध्यमणावपि’ इति विश्वः. .²7 A paradigm or leading example; दशैते स्त्रीषु नायकाः. .²8 An epithet of Śākyamuni.
